breakdown.description: Parameter 'c' value conflicts with the numeric coefficient used in the PDE/ODE section.
breakdown.reason: The Agent correctly identified the conflict between the PDE coefficient (implying c=0.7) and the listed parameter (c=1.4). However, instead of resolving it by choosing the correct value (c=0.7) as shown in the ground truth, it decided to use the incorrect value c=1.4 for the CFL calculation. This fails to fix the inconsistency and propagates the error.
